title: Test Fixtures and Security Tests
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Test Fixtures and Security Tests.
learning_objectives: Explain test fixtures and security tests using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for test fixtures and security tests
Assess failure and operational limits of test fixtures and security tests
concepts_covered: A test attacker calls back during a transfer to test whether a withdrawal can be repeated.
Hardhat tests cover state transitions, timeouts, ERC20, reentrancy, token roles/pausing/royalties, and factory indexing.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
